interval_data_note: recent_activities[].interval_data: plan_match is timeline matching only; compliance summarizes intervals.json session_structure power/time evidence (only that plan-aware source judges completion, per-bout counts and >=95% progression, subject to its context/availability gates); icu_detected is descriptive Intervals.icu interval_summary, not plan-aware. If sources disagree, report both; session_structure judges. Never use device/app lap averages, whole-session average/NP or a set mean as rep power or compliance counts. See SECTION_11.md#which-interval-data-to-use.
